workflows.name: Size up a tech story lead from Hacker News buzz and the project's GitHub repo
steps: In the Hacker News tab, use the Search box (at the bottom of the front page, or at the top if you are already on HN Search), type {project} and press Enter
Note the title, points and date of the top story in the results
Switch to the GitHub tab, click the search box, type {project}, press Enter and open the main {project} repository
Note its star count and the date of its latest release in the right sidebar
Switch to Notes, click "New note", type "Lead: {project}. HN \"<title>\" (<points> pts, <date>); GitHub <stars> stars, last release <date>" and press Enter

workflows.name: Pitch a court story: find a company's latest opinion on CourtListener and its background on Wikipedia
steps: In the CourtListener tab, click the search box, type "{company}" and press Enter
Open the first opinion in the results and note its case name, court and date filed
Switch to the Wikipedia tab, search "{company}" and open the company article; note its headquarters and CEO from the infobox
Switch to the Mail tab, click To and type {editor}@example.com, click Subject and type "Pitch: {company} in court"
Click Body and type "Hi {editor}, <case name> (<court>, filed <date>). {company}: HQ <city>, CEO <name>. Worth a piece?" Do not click Send. Click Discard

workflows.name: Fact-check a country statistic on World Bank data and find news context on BBC
steps: In the World Bank tab, click the search box, type {country} and open the country page
Find {indicator} on the page and note its latest value and year
Switch to the BBC tab, click Search, type "{country} {topic}" and press Enter; open the first result and note its headline and date
Switch to Notes, click "New note", type "Fact-check {country}: {indicator} <value> (<year>). Context: <headline> (<date>)" and press Enter
